headline: Demichelis raves about Yan Diomande ahead of daunting Real Madrid clash
body: Coach Martín Demichelis expresses strong optimism and enthusiasm for his new signing, Yan Diomande, describing him as a key asset before the upcoming match against Real Madrid. The coverage highlights Demichelis's positive outlook and confidence in the team's preparation, framing the challenge against the Spanish giants as a manageable opportunity to showcase the new talent.
